verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Firestore realtime listeners that keep persisted data in sync across clients, and one community anecdote of syncing tile positions to multiple clients. Neither shows a presence-tracking feature (online/offline or connection state) or an ephemeral, non-persisted broadcast channel. Realtime document sync is a building block a developer could use to construct presence, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track user presence and broadcast ephemeral state between connected clients
